name: 🧭 Market Regime Radar
description: Deterministic market-regime classifier for Binance Futures. Reads klines + funding via the binance plugin and labels a symbol as Trend-Up / Trend-Down / Range / High-Vol from EMA slope + ADX/ATR + RSI regime + structure (fractals) + funding bias, with a confidence score and a per-symbol suitability note (which setups fit / to avoid). Advisory only — it does not trade.

commands.name: regime
commands.desc: Classify a symbol's market regime (Trend-Up/Trend-Down/Range/High-Vol) with confidence + suitability. e.g. regime ETHUSDT 1h. Pulls klines/funding from the binance plugin. Advisory only.

commands.name: health
commands.desc: Check the engine is loaded and the binance data bridge is reachable.
